about.description:
This feedstock packages the C++ library `librealsense` and the Python library
`pyrealsense2`. The packages are built enabling the `FORCE_RSUSB_BACKEND`
CMake option, and they are available for all Linux and macOS platforms
supported by conda-forge, including `linux-aarch64` for Nvidia Jetson boards.
CUDA-enabled packages should be selected automatically on CUDA-capable
platforms. Use `librealsense=*=*cuda*` to force a CUDA build or
`librealsense=*=*cpu*` to force a CPU-only build.
about.summary: Cross-platform library for Intel® RealSense™ depth and tracking cameras.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: librealsense
  version: "2.58.3"
  # Order of priority:
  # CUDA (+200)
  # CUDA with arm-variant=tegra (+150)
  # CPU (+0)
  # See https://github.com/conda-forge/librealsense-feedstock/issues/41
  build_number: ${{ 150 if cuda_compiler_version != "None" and target_platform == "linux-aarch64" and arm_variant_type == "tegra" else 200 if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else 0 }}
  build_prefix: ${{ "cuda" ~ (cuda_compiler_version | version_to_buildstring) if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu" }}

recipe:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/IntelRealSense/librealsense/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 6a4c59180950bd9ced58a3dfc4ded586ed22dfc9c418684e7fc8c241b9aaac98
  patches:
    - drop_additional_flags.patch
    - do_not_run_ldconfig_on_install.patch
    - devendor_pybind11.patch
    - devendor_nlohmann_json.patch
    - fix_pybind11_keepalive.patch
    - fix_pyd_windows_install.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  # arm_variant_type is ignored for non-CUDA builds. Avoid building both the
  # sbsa and tegra variants in that case; only CUDA 12.9 supports tegra.
  skip:
    - target_platform == "linux-aarch64" and arm_variant_type == "tegra" and cuda_compiler_version != "12.9"

outputs:
  # Build and install the C++ library and Python bindings once. The librealsense
  # package inherits all staged files, matching the layout of the v0 recipe.
  - staging:
      name: librealsense-build
    build:
      script:
        - if: win
          then: bld.bat
          else: build.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and target_platform == "linux-aarch64"
          then: arm-variant * ${{ arm_variant_type }}
        - cmake <4
        - ninja
        - if: linux
          then: libudev
      host:
        - python
        - if: linux
          then: libudev
        - libusb
        - pybind11
        - pybind11-abi
        - nlohmann_json
        - pybind11_json
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
            - cuda-cudart-dev
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - python

  - package:
      name: librealsense
    inherit: librealsense-build
    build:
      string: ${{ build_prefix }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: __cuda
      run_exports:
        # See https://github.com/IntelRealSense/librealsense/pull/3449
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("librealsense", upper_bound="x.x") }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: not win
            then:
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/librealsense2/rs.hpp
              - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/realsense2/realsense2Config.cmake
          - if: linux
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/librealsense2.so
          - if: osx
            then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/librealsense2.dylib
          - if: win
            then:
              - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\include\librealsense2\rs.hpp exit 1
              - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\lib\realsense2.lib exit 1
              - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\bin\realsense2.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %PREFIX%\Library\lib\cmake\realsense2\realsense2Config.cmake exit 1

  # Compatibility metapackage: the bindings are installed into librealsense,
  # as they were in the v0 recipe. Host numpy contributes its run export.
  - package:
      name: pyrealsense2
    build:
      string: ${{ build_prefix }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
    requirements:
      host:
        - python
        - numpy
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("librealsense", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - pyrealsense2

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/IntelRealSense/librealsense
  repository: https://github.com/IntelRealSense/librealsense
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Cross-platform library for Intel® RealSense™ depth and tracking cameras.
  description: |
    This feedstock packages the C++ library `librealsense` and the Python library
    `pyrealsense2`. The packages are built enabling the `FORCE_RSUSB_BACKEND`
    CMake option, and they are available for all Linux and macOS platforms
    supported by conda-forge, including `linux-aarch64` for Nvidia Jetson boards.
    CUDA-enabled packages should be selected automatically on CUDA-capable
    platforms. Use `librealsense=*=*cuda*` to force a CUDA build or
    `librealsense=*=*cpu*` to force a CPU-only build.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - traversaro
